subject: POC starter kit — cadence, acceptance criteria, and milestone timetable
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Chen <laura@aureliushealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC starter kit — cadence, acceptance criteria, and milestone timetable

Hi Laura — great conversation earlier, thanks for the time. Recapping the call and proposing a tight starter plan so we can get the POC running next week. High-level: who does what, what success looks like, and when we’ll check in.

Call recap (10 min):
- Goal: validate Redwood inference for batch clinical note extraction and 99th-percentile latency under 300ms for typical requests.
- Primary success metrics: accuracy on 500 annotated notes (target >= 92% F1), average token cost < $0.002 per doc, and 95th pct latency < 350ms in staging.
- Resources you’ll provide: 500 de-identified notes (S3 link or secure upload), a small set of evaluation labels (CSV), and an engineer to enable data access.

Proposed milestones and timeline (compact 3‑week POC):
1) Kickoff + environment setup (Day 0 — target Tue 2027-06-01): exchange S3 keys, confirm eval set format, provision test model. Owner: Vanessa (AM) + Jonas (SRE).
2) Baseline run + initial metrics (Day 3–5): run on 100 notes, produce baseline metrics and quick tuning notes. Owner: Redwood engineering (Jonas) + Aurelius engineer.
3) Iteration & guardrails (Week 2): apply prompt/temperature adjustments, quantization profile, and caching config. Owner: Marissa (CS) + Redwood eng.
4) Final readout (Week 3): 500-note evaluation, acceptance check, cost/latency breakdown, and next-step proposal. Owner: Vanessa / Marissa.

Weekly cadence suggestion:
- 30-minute syncs on Tuesdays, 10am PT; asynchronous updates in the shared folder otherwise.

Open questions (please confirm):
- Can you share the de-identified notes by Friday 2027-05-28?
- Do you want Redwood to provision a test S3 bucket or use your environment?
- Any regulatory reviewers who should be looped in now?

Attachments: poc-starter-checklist.xlsx (checklist + data schema)
Drive starter folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ABCxyz-poc-starter
HubSpot link: HubSpot: 78021

If this looks good I’ll send a short calendar invite for the kickoff and loop in Jonas for environment setup.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0132

From: Laura Chen <laura@aureliushealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 13:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC starter kit — cadence, acceptance criteria, and milestone timetable

Thanks Vanessa — that recap is helpful and aligns with what we discussed. A couple quick clarifications: 

- We can provide the 500 de-identified notes by 2027-05-28; we will upload them to a secure S3 bucket (I’ll share access).
- We’d prefer Redwood provision the test bucket if you can manage encryption keys — keeps things simpler for our infra team.
- On success metrics: the clinical reviewers want precision prioritized for certain entity types (medications, dosages). We can provide a 100-note labeled subset focused on those entities to weight the eval. Would that work?

Proposed kickoff dates: 2027-06-01 or 2027-06-02 (morning PT). We can do 60 minutes for kickoff if you need time for environment walkthrough.

Laura Chen
Head of Clinical Data Science | Aurelius Health
laura@aureliushealth.com | (212) 555-0199

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Chen <laura@aureliushealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC starter kit — cadence, acceptance criteria, and milestone timetable

Perfect — thanks for confirming, Laura. We can provision the encrypted test bucket and manage key rotation via your KMS if you provide a cross-account role or temporary credentials. Jonas will handle the S3/KMS setup — looping him in.

Kickoff: let’s lock 2027-06-01, 10:00am PT for a 60-minute session. Agenda (30/60):
- Introductions + success rubric (10 min)
- Data & access walkthrough (15 min)
- Baseline run plan and responsibilities (15 min)
- Quick Q&A and next steps (20 min)

Owners (names + responsibilities):
- Vanessa Ortiz (AM): program lead, weekly syncs, SOW coordination, readout owner.
- Marissa Cole (CS): evaluation plan, prompt tuning, acceptance criteria definitions.
- Jonas Weber (SRE): infra, bucket/KMS, staging provisioning, latency testing.

Next steps on our side (by 2027-05-28):
- Redwood: provision encrypted test bucket and send cross-account role instructions (Jonas).
- Aurelius: upload 500 de-identified notes, share the 100-note labeled subset.
- Vanessa: calendar invite + short kickoff agenda (sent).

Attachments to follow: draft SOW for your review (aurelius_sow_draft.pdf).

If terms look good we’ll aim to have the SOW signed within two business days after the readout.

Thanks — see you on June 1.

Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
